content_sections.heading: About KV No. 1 AFS Jodhpur
content_sections.text: PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1 is a Kendriya Vidyalaya Sangathan school at the Air Force Station in Jodhpur. Its address is Near Pologround, Air Force Station, Ratanada, Jodhpur, Rajasthan - 342011, and its UDISE code is 08151504630. You can contact the school on 0291-2940287 or by email at [email protected] or [email protected] .

content_sections.heading: KV No. 1 AFS Jodhpur PGT and TGT Eligibility 2026
content_sections.text: A two-year Integrated Post Graduate M.Sc course of the Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject; OR a Master Degree from a recognised university with at least 50% marks in aggregate in Physics / Electronics / Applied Physics / Nuclear Physics. A B.Ed. or equivalent degree from a recognised university. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English medium. A four-year Integrated degree course of the Regional College of Education of NCERT in the concerned subject with at least 50% marks in aggregate; OR a Bachelor's Degree with at least 50% marks in the concerned subjects or combination of subjects and in aggregate. For TGT (Science), the subjects are Botany, Zoology and Chemistry. A B.Ed. or equivalent degree from a recognised university. A pass in the Central Teacher Eligibility Test (CTET Level-2), conducted by CBSE in line with NCTE guidelines. Proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English medium. The official notification does not specify the minimum educational qualification. The notice does say that proficiency in teaching in Hindi and English is essential for every category of teacher. Knowledge of computer applications. If no candidates with the required qualification are available, a relaxation may be given, but only with the approval of the competent authority. For the eligibility rules of each post, see the official notification and the KVS website .

content_sections.heading: Selection Process
content_sections.text: Candidates are selected through a walk-in interview, and the interview is used to prepare a panel of contractual teachers. The school will not accept any application after 09:00 AM on the interview day.

content_sections.heading: Service Conditions
content_sections.text: The appointment is purely contractual / part-time and covers the 2026-27 academic session only. All terms and conditions are subject to KVS rules. No TA/DA will be paid for attending the interview.

content_sections.heading: How to Apply for KV No. 1 AFS Jodhpur PGT and TGT Recruitment 2026
content_sections.text: Register on the KVS Samvida Sathi portal . Registration is mandatory. Fill in the form on the portal and download the completed application form. If you are applying for more than one post, submit a separate application for each post. On 4 November 2026, report to PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1, Near Pologround, Air Force Station, Ratanada, Jodhpur, and hand in the form by 09:00 AM. Bring the following: The duly filled application form downloaded from Samvida Sathi Original documents for every qualification mentioned in the application form Self-attested photocopies of all required documents

faq.question: Q1. When and where is the KV No. 1 AFS Jodhpur walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The interview is on 4 November 2026 from 09:00 AM at PM SHRI Kendriya Vidyalaya No. 1, Near Pologround, Air Force Station, Ratanada, Jodhpur - 342011.

faq.question: Q2. Is registration on Samvida Sathi compulsory?
faq.answer: Yes. Candidates must register on samvida-sathi.kvs.gov.in and bring the downloaded filled form to the interview.

faq.question: Q3. What is the pay for PGT Physics?
faq.answer: PGT (Physics) pays Rs.27500/-, and the TGT rate is Rs.26250/-. Pay follows KVS guidelines for contractual teachers.

faq.question: Q4. Is CTET required for TGT Science?
faq.answer: Yes. TGT (Science) requires a pass in CTET Level-2 conducted by CBSE, as well as a B.Ed. or equivalent degree.

faq.question: Q5. What marks do I need for PGT Physics?
faq.answer: You need a Master Degree with at least 50% marks in aggregate in Physics, Electronics, Applied Physics or Nuclear Physics, or the two-year integrated M.Sc course of an NCERT Regional College of Education.

faq.question: Q6. Can I apply for both TGT and PGT?
faq.answer: Yes. Submit a separate application for each post.

faq.question: Q7. Will I get travel allowance for attending the interview?
faq.answer: No. The notice states that no TA/DA will be paid to candidates for the interview.

faq.question: Q8. Can I submit my form after 09:00 AM?
faq.answer: No. The form and attested photocopies must be submitted by 09:00 AM on 4 November 2026. No application will be accepted after that.

faq.question: Q9. Is this a permanent job?
faq.answer: No. The appointment is purely contractual / part-time for the 2026-27 session, and all terms are subject to KVS rules.
